text:
maria: Quick heads-up — onboarding report: sampleapp CLI sets ephemeral project tokens into env as `RW_EPHEMERAL_TOKEN` but SDK expects `REDWOOD_EPHEMERAL_KEY`. Causing our sampleapps to break during key rotation.
kevin: ah. where is CLI writing that? to ~/.redwood/config or stdout?
maria: it prints: `export RW_EPHEMERAL_TOKEN=...` and also writes to ~/.redwood/last_token
sophia: that's the weird part — the Go SDK checks env in this order: 1) REDWOOD_API_KEY, 2) REDWOOD_EPHEMERAL_KEY, 3) RW_EPHEMERAL_TOKEN, 4) ~/.redwood/last_token. The intended order is project-scoped env -> org-scoped env -> ephemeral -> config file (so step 2 and 3 should be swapped). There's a test missing.
kevin: oof. So Go SDK breaks when CLI only sets RW_EPHEMERAL_TOKEN. Repro steps?
maria: use the sampleapp: `./sampleapp --use-ephemeral` then `env | grep EPHEMERAL`. SDK returns 401.
devex-bot: New issue created: GH#3842 — "env precedence mismatch Go SDK" (https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/3842)
triage-bot: assigning to @sophia per label "devex-sdk"
sophia: Proposed fix: normalize env var names across SDKs and make the fallback table explicit in code. Also, SDK should log a single-line warning when using an env var that's deprecated: e.g., `WARN: RW_EPHEMERAL_TOKEN is deprecated; prefer REDWOOD_EPHEMERAL_KEY (will be removed in 2 releases)`.
kevin: +1. Also suggest CLI switch `--export=redwood` to emit `export REDWOOD_EPHEMERAL_KEY=...` for parity. That avoids changing code in older SDKs.
maria: Can we also add a small heuristic: if an ephemeral token is present but expired, attempt refresh via CLI endpoint (if CLI is installed) before failing? Might help onboarding.
sophia: I'm wary: automatic refresh across process boundaries is surprising. Maybe offer a helper binary `redwood-refresh` that returns a fresh token and exit 0, and SDKs can call it if present and env var flagged `REDWOOD_TRY_REFRESH=1`.
kevin: ok. Action items: 1) sophia open PR to swap precedence and add tests + deprecation warning. 2) devex create CLI PR for `--export=redwood`. 3) docs: update onboarding snippet. I'll open the PRs now.
maria: thanks. tagging @all: can we include a tiny sample in docs showing fallback table and recommended env var names? Keeps things consistent for customers :thumbsup:
sophia: I'll add the sample and a one-liner table in 'devex/onboarding' docs. planning to land by EOW.
kevin: if anyone wants to be reviewer ping me. I'll test with windows shell semantics as well.
maria: perfect. closing loop once GH#3842 has PRs. :rocket:
